crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct semi-circular reddish-brown patch is visible on the posterior crown and nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A clear, curved demarcation line separates the reddish-brown nape from the solid gray-brown mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible transverse black and white banding across the dorsal surface of the rectrices (tail feathers).
